title: Variables and Naming Data Quiz
description: Check your understanding of Variables and Naming Data.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of Variables and Naming Data?

options.text: Variable names should describe the value they store.
This concept is only used for deleting files.

questions.questionText: What should you do when reading a small Python example?
questions.codeSnippet:
username = "Nova"
level = 1
print("User:", username)

options.text: Read it line by line and predict the result
Ignore the order of the lines
Assume Python will fix mistakes automatically
